nodes.description: Owner address of the Ownable contract; initialized in the constructor and overwritten by transferOwnership.
Mapping(address=>uint256) of token balances used by transfer, transferFrom, balanceOf and the DCETToken constructor.
Total token supply; set once in the DCETToken constructor to INITIAL_SUPPLY.
Nested mapping(owner=>spender=>uint256) allowance table used by approve, allowance and transferFrom.
Constant token name 'Decentralized Faucet'.
Constant token symbol 'DCET'.
Constant token decimals value (0).
Constant initial supply 2000000000 * 10**decimals used by the DCETToken constructor.
Library multiplication that asserts c / a == b to guard against overflow.
Library division helper; Solidity reverts automatically on division by zero.
Library subtraction that asserts b <= a before returning a - b.
Library addition that asserts c >= a to guard against overflow.
Ownable constructor assigning owner to a hard-coded address 0x482149F62258F6202D13e5219C92A6f9611Bf82d.
Modifier that requires msg.sender == owner before running the guarded function body.
Owner-only function that rejects the zero address, emits OwnershipTransferred and writes owner = newOwner.
View getter returning totalSupply_.
ERC20 transfer: checks _to != 0 and balance sufficiency, then debits msg.sender and credits _to via SafeMath.
View getter returning balances[_owner].
Spends msg.sender allowance to move tokens from _from to _to; mutates balances and allowed via SafeMath.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value with no zero-address or double-spend check.
View getter returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Payable fallback that immediately reverts, rejecting direct ETH transfers to the token contract.
Owner-only rescue function that performs an external call BasicToken(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary caller-supplied token address.
Batches transfers: requires array length <= 255 and equal lengths, then loops calling transfer() for every recipient.
Batches transferFrom calls from _from: requires length <= 255 and equal lengths, loops over the arrays.
Token constructor that sets totalSupply_ = INITIAL_SUPPLY and credits the full supply to the hard-coded owner address.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance debits and allowance lookups.
Arithmetic balances[msg.sender].sub(_value) and balances[_to].add(_value) inside transfer.
Arithmetic on balances[_from], balances[_to] and allowed[_from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
External call BasicToken(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) where tokenAddress is fully attacker-controlled.
uint8 loop counter i incremented in multiSend and multiSendFrom while arrays are bounded to 255 entries.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner inside the onlyOwner modifier to authorize privileged calls.

onlyOwner gates execution of transferAnyERC20Token.
newOwner parameter is validated and written into the owner slot.
transferOwnership assigns the owner state variable.
Ownable constructor initializes owner to a hard-coded address.
msg.sender balances are read and debited in transfer.
_to parameter is the credit target of transfer.
_value parameter determines the amount moved by transfer.
transfer mutates the balances mapping.
transfer performs balances subtraction and addition arithmetic.
transfer relies on SafeMath.sub for the sender balance decrement.
transfer relies on SafeMath.add for the recipient balance increment.

_to parameter is the credited address in transferFrom.

transferFrom updates the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom performs subtraction/addition on balances and allowance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add for the recipient balance increment.

msg.sender is the allowance owner recorded by approve.
approve writes into the allowed mapping.
_owner parameter keys the allowance lookup.
_spender parameter keys the allowance lookup.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
tokenAddress parameter becomes the external call target.
tokens parameter is the amount passed to the external token transfer.

owner address is passed as the recipient of the rescued tokens.
